verdict.rationale: Letta exposes programmatic surfaces such as the Agent SDK and the App Server's OpenAI-compatible API, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path, and no evidence documents a machine-readable spec. The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented documentation rather than an API specification, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
